description: Phase 7 slice 1 (base 464806f). tests/route-authority.test.ts: 'unbound' lists routes/*.ts handlers that no registry operation route names, each with a reason; 'cannedBaseline' is the ratcheted list of handlers that answer with literal numbers/booleans without calling an authority. Both lists may only shrink; stale entries fail the test. 'unclassified' keys of use mounts carry their site (file#ordinal of that path's mounts in the file); the ceiling caps them by path and by site count per path. Route behaviour is unchanged.

unbound.GET /api/health: Infrastructure (server.ts): liveness and API-key presence flag.
unbound.GET /api/runtime-config: Infrastructure (server.ts): air-gap configuration for the UI banner.
unbound.ALL /api/*: Infrastructure (server.ts): explicit JSON 404 for unmatched /api routes.
unbound.GET /api/python/status: Infrastructure: engine availability for the App.tsx status dialog.
unbound.POST /api/python/xrd-deconvolve: Python XRD route; the service method has no caller in src/.
unbound.GET /api/research/registry/history: Research registry sub-resource of the research-hub research-registry operation.
unbound.GET /api/research/registry/revisions/:re: Research registry sub-resource of the research-hub research-registry operation.
unbound.POST /api/lpbf/runs/:runId/nist-comparis: LPBF run archive NIST comparison (node service over archived runs).
unbound.POST /api/lpbf/runs/bundles/restores/:re: LPBF run bundle NIST comparison (node service over restored runs).

unclassified.USE /api/lpbf (routes/lpbfSimulation.ts#: routes/lpbfSimulation.ts same-origin guard middleware for /api/lpbf; calls next(), answers only 403 error envelopes.
unclassified.USE /api/lpbf/sources (routes/lpbfSource: routes/lpbfSources.ts guard (no-store, read-only/origin/content-type checks); calls next() or answers error envelopes; no result payload.
routes/lpbfSources.ts body-size/JSON error handler (bodyError); answers 413/400 error envelopes only.
unclassified.USE /api/lpbf/runs (routes/lpbfRuns.ts#1: routes/lpbfRuns.ts no-store/guard middleware; calls next() or answers error envelopes; no result payload.
unclassified.USE /api/lpbf/runs (routes/lpbfRuns.ts#2: routes/lpbfRuns.ts body-size/JSON error handler (bodyError); answers 413/400 error envelopes only.
unclassified.USE /api/research/registry (routes/resea: routes/researchRegistry.ts no-store header, same-origin guard and JSON parser mount; no result payload.

cannedBaseline.GET /api/health: server.ts liveness: 'hasApiKey: AIRGAPPED ? false : <runtime check>' trips the ternary-of-literals rule. Transport metadata, not a result; heuristic false positive kept visible.
